output.answer: Count the marks in each column of the table. Slow: cars 2, 3, 6, 9, 10, 11, 13, 16, 18 = 9 cars (the existing bar already shows 9). Medium: cars 1, 7, 8, 12, 17, 19 = 6 cars. Fast: cars 4, 5, 14, 15, 20 = 5 cars. Check: 9 + 6 + 5 = 20. To complete the graph, draw a bar of the same width in the Medium column rising to 6, just above the 5 tick mark and below the 10 mark, and draw a bar in the Fast column rising to 5, level with the 5 tick mark.
